### SameShare(CommunityEntry, CommunityEntry) { #m-sameshare-nfty-core-publish-community-communityentry-n-e8b997 }

```csharp
public static bool SameShare(CommunityEntry a, CommunityEntry b);
```

True when every shared field is equal; [`CommunityEntry.Updated`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.CommunityEntry.md#p-updated) is ignored and [`CommunityEntry.Tags`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.CommunityEntry.md#p-tags) compare as a sequence.

**Parameters**
